profile.name: Nguyen Manh Dung
profile.title: Backend Software Engineer
profile.location: Tan Phu, Ho Chi Minh City
profile.careerObjective: Aiming to grow into a Senior Backend Engineer / Technical Lead within the next 3 years, taking ownership of system architecture and driving technical decisions for high-scale, distributed platforms. Seeking an environment that values engineering ownership, cross-team collaboration, and continuous learning — where I can apply deep backend expertise to build reliable, scalable systems while mentoring and growing alongside the team.
profile.summary: Backend Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience specializing in high-concurrency systems using Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS) and AWS. Skilled in designing core system architecture — including newsfeed ranking, distributed locking, and service migration — for production systems serving 20K+ users at 2,000 req/s peak. Proven track record of delivering up to 80% latency reduction and minimizing data loss incidents under traffic surges, with strong fundamentals in system design, concurrency control, and cross-service communication (gRPC, RabbitMQ, GraphQL).
